svg.title: Engineering drawing of Rene Vincent Cosme's work, drawn in on load. Business systems: React and Vite, Node and Express, SQLite and Postgres, with 4,000+ tests on the ANF system; requests flow between them. AI systems: EyeDTrack, a Kotlin app and Python server running MobileNetV2 and LLaVA; camera frames travel the pipeline in about 0.95 seconds from camera to alert at 87.12% accuracy. Timeline: co-founded Pookies August 2023, led the EyeDTrack thesis February 2025, Highly Succeed internship March 2026, built the ANF system May 2026, Araneta City web internship July 2026, marked as the latest revision.
